description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from two-photon calcium imaging experiments on Drosophila olfactory neurons exposed to odorant stimuli.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or imaging event within the dataset.

experiment_id.descr: Identifier linking records from the same biological experiment/session.

subject_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual fly or preparation.

species.descr: Organism species; expected value is Drosophila melanogaster.

strain_or_line.descr: Fly strain, transgenic line, or genetic background (e.g., GAL4/UAS line names).

genotype.descr: Full genotype description of the animal used in the experiment.

sex.descr: Biological sex of the fly; e.g., male, female, unknown.

age_days.descr: Age of the fly at the time of imaging, in days post-eclosion.

preparation_type.descr: Experimental preparation used, such as intact, dissected brain, or ex vivo preparation.

brain_region.descr: Primary brain region imaged, such as antennal lobe, mushroom body, or lateral horn.

roi_id.descr: Identifier for the region of interest used for signal extraction.

roi_anatomical_label.descr: Anatomical label or cell/neuropil name assigned to the ROI.

roi_annotation_method.descr: Method used to define the ROI, such as manual tracing, atlas registration, or automated segmentation.

roi_area_um2.descr: Area of the ROI in square micrometers (um^2), if available.

roi_volume_um3.descr: Volume of the ROI in cubic micrometers (um^3), if available.

indicator_type.descr: Calcium indicator used, such as GCaMP6f, GCaMP7, or other reporter.

imaging_modality.descr: Imaging modality used; expected value is two-photon microscopy.

microscope_model.descr: Manufacturer and model of the microscope system.

numerical_aperture.descr: Numerical aperture of the objective lens.

laser_power_mw.descr: Laser power at the sample in milliwatts (mW).

frame_rate_hz.descr: Acquisition frame rate in Hertz (frames per second).

temporal_resolution_s.descr: Time between successive frames in seconds.

image_depth_slices.descr: Number of z-slices in the imaging stack, if volumetric data were acquired.

field_of_view_um.descr: Spatial field of view in micrometers; use a consistent representation such as width x height in a single string if needed.

acquisition_datetime.descr: Date and time when the imaging record was acquired, in ISO 8601 format if possible.

recording_duration_s.descr: Total duration of the imaging recording in seconds.

baseline_duration_s.descr: Duration of baseline recording before odor stimulation, in seconds.

odorant_name.descr: Name of the odorant stimulus presented, using a standard chemical name where possible.

odorant_cas_number.descr: CAS registry number for the odorant, if known.

odorant_purity_percent.descr: Purity of the odorant compound in percent (%), if known.

odorant_concentration.descr: Concentration of odorant delivered, in molar (M), percent (%), or another stated unit as captured in the accompanying description.

odorant_concentration_unit.descr: Unit for odorant concentration, such as M, mM, uM, %, or dilution ratio.

odor_delivery_method.descr: Method used to deliver the odorant, such as olfactometer, puff system, or carrier-air dilution.

odor_pulse_duration_s.descr: Duration of odor exposure in seconds.

odor_onset_time_s.descr: Time from recording start to odor onset, in seconds.

odor_offset_time_s.descr: Time from recording start to odor offset, in seconds.

odor_repetition_index.descr: Index of the stimulus presentation within repeated trials.

inter_stimulus_interval_s.descr: Time between odor presentations in seconds.

stimulus_order.descr: Order of odor presentation within the experimental session.

carrier_gas.descr: Carrier gas used for odor delivery, such as air or nitrogen.

humidity_percent.descr: Relative humidity during acquisition, in percent (%).

temperature_c.descr: Temperature during acquisition, in degrees Celsius (C).

behavior_state.descr: Behavioral state of the fly during imaging, such as awake, anesthetized, restrained, or walking.

motion_correction_applied.descr: Whether motion correction was applied to the imaging data.

motion_correction_method.descr: Method or software used for motion correction, if applied.

neuropil_correction_applied.descr: Whether neuropil correction was applied to ROI fluorescence traces.

neuropil_correction_method.descr: Method used for neuropil correction, if applied.

quality_flag.descr: General quality assessment of the record, such as pass, caution, or fail.

signal_to_noise_ratio.descr: Signal-to-noise ratio of the ROI trace or response estimate.

delta_f_over_f_peak.descr: Peak fluorescence response expressed as delta F over F (ΔF/F), unitless.

response_latency_s.descr: Latency from odor onset to response onset or peak, in seconds.

response_duration_s.descr: Duration of the calcium response above threshold, in seconds.

data_file_path.descr: File path or URI to the primary imaging data file for this record.

analysis_file_path.descr: File path or URI to the processed analysis output for this record, if available.

notes.descr: Free-text comments about the record, including exceptions, artifacts, or experimental details not captured elsewhere.
